description: You are a fixed-income portfolio analyst at an institutional asset manager. Microsoft Excel 2010 is open with bond_portfolio.xlsx. The 'Portfolio' sheet contains 10 bonds (Treasuries, corporates, and municipals) with their coupon rates, maturity dates, par values, and yield-to-maturity figures. Complete the 'Duration_Analysis' sheet with the following calculations for each of the 10 bonds: (1) Years to Maturity from settlement date 1/15/2024, (2) Market Value in dollars (Par × Price/100), (3) Macaulay Duration in years using Excel's DURATION function, (4) Modified Duration in years using Excel's MDURATION function, (5) DV01 in dollars (Modified Duration × Market Value / 10000), (6) Convexity approximation, (7) Duration Flag — enter 'DURATION_BREACH' for any bond where Modified Duration exceeds 7.0 years, otherwise leave blank. Then fill in the Portfolio Totals section with: the market-value-weighted average Modified Duration, total portfolio DV01, and total portfolio market value. Complete the 'Shock_Scenario' sheet with: each bond's P&L impact for a +100bps, -100bps, and +50bps parallel rate shock (P&L = -1 × Modified Duration × shock_in_decimal × Market Value). Fill in the Totals row for each shock scenario. Save the completed workbook as C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\ExcelTasks\bond_portfolio.xlsx using Ctrl+S.

metadata.data_source: Treasury YTMs from US Treasury par yield curve Jan 15 2024 (2yr=4.37%, 10yr=4.05%, 30yr=4.27%); corporate spreads from ICE BofA BAMLC0A0CM OAS ~93bps Jan 2024; muni yields from MSRB EMMA ~3.0-3.2% AAA 10yr Jan 2024
